incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: kv-cache eviction rate spike on prod-cluster-3. Eviction rate 28% over 5m, hit_rate dropped from 92% -> 64%. Paging eng-oncall.

alina (oncall): saw it, taking. Can someone confirm customer-facing requests affected?

devin (sre): see increased 5xxs on /generate when cache miss rate spikes, correlates with eviction windows. A few customers saw latency spikes, not total outage :grimacing:

ray (runtime): tagging in — probable cause is cache pressure after a failed roll earlier today; memcached pods haven't scaled back to normal. Also seeing a flurry of short-lived keys from a noisy client.

alina (oncall): ok, immediate mitigation — let's increase cache pool size and add temporary rate-limit on that noisy client. Devin, can you bump memcached resource limit for pool-3?

devin (sre): doing now. kubectl patch statefulset memcache-pool-3 -n infra --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"memcached","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"6Gi"},"requests":{"memory":"6Gi"}}}]}}}}'

ops-bot: Deploy started for memcache-pool-3 (rollout id: r-20240321-17). ETA ~2m.

alina (oncall): also creating a temporary alert silence for repeated eviction alerts for 30m to avoid alert fatigue while we stabilize. Will document in thread.

taylor (sre): +1. Suggest we change the alert to require sustained >20% for 3m -> 10m. Current is 1m which triggered on short transient.

ray (runtime): can we add a KV label to exclude the noisy client from prefix-based caching while we investigate? Quick patch:

```
# add client filter in cache config
cache.config.exclude_prefixes = ["/api/noisy-client/"]
```

samira (pm): flagging impacted customers: acme-inc and fastchat. Ops, please ping CS for heads-up.

devin (sre): memcached resize rolled, pods back to Ready. Eviction rate dropped to 4% in last 2m. Hit_rate recovering to 89%.

alina (oncall): nice. Removing immediate silence in 20m unless we still see noise. Leaving a follow-up: we need a new dashboard tile that shows eviction rate, hit rate, and top 5 key prefixes by eviction count.

ray (runtime): I'll add a Grafana panel and a pinned query. Proposed alert rule change (planning):

```
- alert: KVCacheHighEviction
  expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[10m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_inserts_total[10m])) > 0.2
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

alina (oncall): looks good. Also change notification to page only if severity=page and after-hours SLO group. Otherwise go to #eng-sre.

devin (sre): added a quick dashboard tile: "KV Cache — hit/evict/top prefixes" and a heatmap for prefix churn. PMs notified.

samira (pm): thanks. I'll send a brief note to CS and affected customers. No SLA breach but visible degradation.

alina (oncall): post-incident actions: (1) update runbook with noisy-client mitigation steps, (2) change alert window to 10m, (3) deploy dashboard tile to main prod board, (4) set up a weekly job to list high-churn prefixes. Assigning owners: ray -> dashboard & prefix job, devin -> alert rule change, taylor -> runbook update.

ray (runtime): will do. Also proposing a small change to add exponential backoff to prefix TTLs to avoid cascades.

taylor (sre): noted. I'll open a PR for runbook edits and include the paging criteria.

alina (oncall): thanks team. Closing the page. :thumbsup: If anyone sees the eviction trend come back, re-open.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (id: inc-20240321-79). Duration 22m. Actions logged: dashboards/alerts/runbook owners assigned.

ops-bot: Follow-up ticket created: INF-8423 "Reduce KV eviction alert noise & add prefix churn dashboard" assigned to ray, devin, taylor.

alina (oncall): will run a quick retro in eng-oncall tomorrow 10am to refine thresholds.

devin (sre): one more note — we should consider per-tenant quotas on cache insertion to prevent single tenants from poisoning the whole pool.

ray (runtime): agreed. Adding to design doc.

samira (pm): thank you all. :heart:
